a.startedConfig:
frr version 10.6.1
frr defaults traditional
hostname a
log file /var/log/frr/a.log
log timestamp precision 3
service integrated-vtysh-config
!
ip route 10.0.2.0/30 10.0.1.2
!
interface a-b
 ip address 10.0.1.1/30
exit
!
